weakness: No account procedure, approvals, role definitions, or reviews; former Customer Success Manager and a transferred employee kept admin console access
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-010; P03 G-016
remediation_plan: Onboarding and offboarding checklists covering every system; admin console and support desk behind single sign-on; monthly account reconciliation
milestones: 2026-08-26 stale accounts removed; 2026-10-31 checklists in use; 2026-11-30 first monthly reconciliation recorded
resources_required: Operations and Finance Manager time (1 hour a month); CTO time

weakness: Five people and the CI key hold full administrator rights in production
remediation_plan: Read-only, deploy-only, and break-glass roles; break-glass limited to the CTO and Senior Software Engineer with logging; contractor gets deploy-only
milestones: 2026-10-31 roles created; 2026-11-30 standing administrator rights removed

weakness: Admin console accepts a password alone; root account MFA on a personal phone
remediation_plan: Hardware security key for root and restricted vault entry; admin console behind suite single sign-on with MFA; hardware keys for the CTO and both engineers
milestones: 2026-10-15 root key and vault change; 2026-11-30 admin console on single sign-on

weakness: Long-lived CI administrator key never rotated and copied to a personal laptop; unrotated application secrets in environment variables
source: P07 (IA-05 objectives); P01 R-001, R-024; P03 G-007; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: Short-lived federated CI credentials; delete the key; move secrets to the provider's secrets manager and rotate; compromised-key procedure
milestones: 2026-10-08 federated CI credentials live; 2026-10-15 key deleted and secrets rotated

weakness: No object read logging, database audit logging, threat detection, or archive
source: P07 (AU-02 objectives); P01 R-001; P03 G-014; P04 finding 2
remediation_plan: Turn on bucket read logging, database audit logging, and threat detection; 1-year archive in a separate account; document chosen event types and rationale

weakness: No review of logs or alerts
remediation_plan: Weekly review of administrator activity and alerts; monthly admin console session review; record each review

weakness: Documents not backed up (no versioning); backups not write-once, in the production account, and kept 7 days instead of 30
source: P07 (CP-09 test); P01 R-007, R-002; P03 G-039; P05 finding 3
remediation_plan: Bucket versioning; copies of snapshots and bucket versions to a separate backup account with 35-day write-once retention

weakness: No contingency plan and no restore test
source: P07 (CP-04 objectives); P01 R-008; P05 finding 1
remediation_plan: Timed restore test of the database and a document sample; short contingency plan and recovery runbook; tests twice a year

weakness: No incident reporting rule and no customer security contact list
source: P07 (IR-06 interviews); P01 R-009; P03 G-031, G-035
remediation_plan: POL-03 1-hour reporting rule briefed to all staff; customer security contact list; counsel-approved templates; tabletop
resources_required: Counsel review of templates (about $1,500, within the P06 budget)

weakness: AI model provider on click-through terms and not listed; no provider oversight
remediation_plan: Model provider DPA with zero retention; list and notify customers with a 30-day objection window; annual review of each sub-processor
milestones: 2026-10-31 DPA signed and customers notified; 2026-12-31 reviews of all 5 sub-processors complete

weakness: Production extracts with vendor tax IDs on laptops, including the contractor's personal laptop
source: P07 (SA-03(02) objectives); P01 R-003; P03 G-003
remediation_plan: Stop extracts; delete all copies with written confirmation; synthetic test data set
milestones: 2026-08-28 contractor's extracts deleted (confirmed in writing); 2026-10-31 synthetic data set in use

weakness: Full tax IDs visible to all customer users; extracts on an unmanaged laptop
remediation_plan: Mask Social Security numbers before AI and logs; store TIN type and last 4 digits as fields; full view for customer administrators only

weakness: No image or endpoint scanning; overdue High alerts; no time limits
source: P07 (RA-05 objectives); P01 R-013; P03 G-020, G-023
remediation_plan: Image scanning in CI; time limits by severity; clear the 14 overdue alerts; external penetration test
milestones: 2026-11-30 scanning and limits in force; 2027-01-31 penetration test complete

weakness: Contractor and MSP have no security terms; contractor works on an unmanaged personal laptop
source: P07 (PS-07 objectives); P01 R-003, R-012; P03 G-015
remediation_plan: Security addendum for the contractor (company laptop, incident reporting, return of data); MSP contract terms for incident notice and named administrators
milestones: 2026-10-31 contractor addendum signed and company laptop issued; 2026-12-31 MSP terms agreed
